name: core.openwop.workflows.weekly-digest
description: Weekly-digest chains (RFC 0013): scheduled roundups that keep a team informed without a meeting — a research digest on a watched topic, and a team status roll-up. In-app + gated-send sinks; replay-deterministic.
author: openwop

chains.label: Weekly Topic Watch → Digest
chains.description: A scheduled research digest: searches a watched topic, summarizes what's new with sources, and posts an in-app notification.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

scheduleCron.description: Cron expression for when this workflow runs (e.g. `0 9 * * 1` = Mondays 09:00).

config.systemPrompt: You are a research analyst. From the search results, write a weekly digest on {{params.topic}}: the 3-5 most notable developments, each a headline + one-line why-it-matters + source. Ground every item in a result; say 'quiet week' if little is new rather than padding. If the search results' `engine` field is 'demo' or 'stub' they are PLACEHOLDERS, not research: do not treat them as findings or invent specifics from them — say plainly that live web search is not configured (a 'web-search' key on the keys page unlocks it) and stop there.

chains.label: Weekly Team Status → Roll-Up
chains.description: Rolls a week of status updates into a concise leadership summary (wins, risks, asks) and sends it to the channel after a human review.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

scheduleCron.description: Cron expression for when this workflow runs (e.g. `0 9 * * 1` = Mondays 09:00).

slackChannel.description: Slack channel these messages post to (e.g. `#ops`).

config.systemPrompt: Roll these team status updates into a concise leadership summary: Wins · Risks/blockers (with the ask each needs) · Notable in-flight work. Ground everything in the updates; flag stale or missing areas rather than inventing progress.

config.title: Review the status roll-up before posting
